next_gate.why_V6_first: R50G11 proves any all-doors-closed obstruction has at least 6 total variables. The minimal boundary must therefore be attacked exactly before any larger-domain search.
V6_target_lemma: With exactly six total variables {x}+five alternates, any closed alternate y has chi_star exactly 5, because closed R49H needs >=5 and non-taut width cannot exceed the five variables other than y.
The chi witness for y therefore touches every other variable, including x.
Closed R47J removes y with no fresh variables and ends nonterminal wide; with only five variables left its final width is exactly 5 and any widest clause touches every other variable.
After removing distinguished x, both debt graphs on the five alternates are complete directed K5 without self-loops.

This is an additional conditional debt, not by itself a contradiction.
